reviews.title: Good boom box, but not great.
reviews.review_text: All depends on how loud you wanna "boom". On loud volume the sound distorts. Lower is ok. Otherwise it's fine.

reviews.title: Doesn't work well as a CD player
reviews.review_text: I was very pleased with the blue tooth feature..it worked perfectly. But, my main reason for purchasing this product was to play my CDs. All was fine for the first 10 minutes...then the noise began and shortly after all sound came to an end. I'm returning it.

reviews.title: An affordable bluetooth speaker with an AC cord
reviews.review_text: I only bought this to have a way to play mp3s using bluetooth. Who listens to CDs or the radio these days? Not me. I never tried the CD player nor the radio, so I have no idea if they even work. But the bluetooth works great and is easy to use. I also love the fact that it comes with an AC cord, so you just plug it in and forget about it. No need to charge it up like most bluetooth speakers. The only problem is that the volume is not super loud. This is fine for a small room or if you are using it at your desk, but this would not work well outside or in a big or noisy room. You would not be able to hear it.

reviews.title: Fm, cd radio
reviews.review_text: I purchased this item today. I was searching for a portable am/fm radio with Bluetooth. It's not the best option but you get what you pay for. It will do for the time being until I find something with better sounding speakers and faster Bluetooth connection
